convertibility_reason: Uses custom signal filter CML_Stoch from external .mqh library (Expert\Signal\MySignals\ACML_Stoch.mqh), which contains the core trading logic not available as a built-in MT5 indicator

derived_values.name: Signal weighted score from CML_Stoch filter

other_exits: Signal score drops below Signal_ThresholdClose (20) triggers close via CExpertSignal logic

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size; Percent field (10.0) used for margin validation but lots are fixed at 0.1

custom_logic_notes: CML_Stoch is a custom signal filter combining Stochastic(3,36,25) with a MA(3) filter. The exact entry/exit logic (crossover vs level-based) is encapsulated in the external ACML_Stoch.mqh library and not visible in this EA file. CExpertSignal uses a weighted voting system where filter scores are compared against threshold values (40 to open, 20 to close). Expert_EveryTick=false means signal evaluation occurs once per bar, not on every tick. Pending orders may be used with expiration of 6 bars when Signal_PriceLevel != 0.
python_conversion_notes: The CML_Stoch custom signal logic in ACML_Stoch.mqh must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately before Python conversion. The CExpert/CExpertSignal framework implements a weighted filter voting system that needs to be replicated: each filter returns a score 0-100, multiplied by weight, then compared against threshold. Stochastic(3,36,25) is non-standard (very slow D period) and must be implemented with matching calculation. The MA(3) period within CML_Stoch needs its application method confirmed from the .mqh source. No SL/TP digit adjustment logic present. Fixed lot sizing simplifies conversion.
